name: best_vary_radius
description: Best-spot isolate (warm-start). Fixed at sel_sigma 0.2, n_select 100, mix_ratio 0.5, Weakpoint distance, top-3 detectors; sweeps the induced weakspot gap size (radius, 0 = no gap) AND initial-training time iters_initial [10,20,50,100,200] (brackets the ~50 whole-area sweet spot). Maps how gap size and initial-model strength jointly decide where guided beats random over the whole area vs only in the gap. 10 radius x 5 iters_initial x 3 seeds = 150 configs.
